rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and occupant injuries; clear auto claim under comprehensive/collision coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 am while stationary; the other vehicle hit at approximately 35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report and other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat
